desc:
🏠 You’ve been hired as a moving company employee!
Your job is simple: clear out the entire house and load everything into the truck! 📦

📦 Grab furniture, boxes, and everything else you can find!
🚚 Carry it outside and load it into the moving truck!
💰 Earn money and buy upgrades to make moving easier!
💪 Work together with friends!
⭐ Your progress saves! Even in multiplayer!
💎 Multiple different maps and difficulties available!

👍 Like the game for more updates!
